name: xbert-policy-review
description: Weekly review of posted spend against firm + client policy XBerts (out-of-policy categories, vendor anomalies, missing receipts, forensic flags).

x-xbert.tagline: Weekly review of posted spend against firm + client policy XBerts (out-of-policy categories, vendor anomalies, missing receipts, forensic flags).
prerequisites: Policy XBerts linked to the Policy Review agent in the Connect portal
x-xbert.longDescription:
Spend policy is enforced deterministically by Custom XBerts — out-of-policy categories, banned vendors, mileage-over-threshold, duplicate submissions, missing-receipt-after-N-days, plus the forensic signals on captured receipts (copy-move, metadata tampering, greyscale conversion, image-of-an-image). The XBerts do the detection; this plugin does not.

XBert Policy Review orchestrates the weekly periodic review of what the policy XBerts flagged. Violations are grouped by category, per-violation follow-ups are drafted with the spender's tone and context, and an audit pack is produced.

The selling shape: pre-spend enforcement plus periodic review. Where US-style products (Navan, Ramp, Klippa) block the spend at the moment of purchase, XBert Policy Review recasts the same control as a weekly review workflow that fits how Australian and UK firms already work.

useCases.title: Weekly spend review
useCases.description: Every Monday morning, sweep every policy XBert that fired across the prior week, group by category, and draft follow-ups for the spenders concerned.

useCases.title: Pre-period-close policy sweep
useCases.description: Before the month closes, ensure every policy violation is either resolved with the spender or escalated for write-off.

useCases.title: New-employee onboarding pulse
useCases.description: In the first 60 days after a new employee starts spending, run a tighter weekly review to catch and correct patterns early.

useCases.title: Vendor-anomaly investigation
useCases.description: When the same vendor keeps tripping forensic flags, the policy review surfaces the recurring pattern and drives a vendor-master decision.

benefits.title: Policy XBerts enforce deterministically
benefits.description: Out-of-policy categories, banned vendors, missing-receipt thresholds, mileage caps — every rule is owned by a deterministic XBert. The plugin reasons only over what fired.

benefits.title: Forensic flags surfaced
benefits.description: Receipt forensic signals (copy-move, metadata tampering, greyscale, image-of-image) caught by Capture XBerts are surfaced in-line with the policy review.

benefits.title: Audit pack output
benefits.description: Outputs a workpaper grouped by violation category with drafted spender follow-ups and a QMS block — filable straight into the client folder.

workflow: Confirm the client and the review period (default: prior week)
Plugin resolves the linked policy XBerts for the period — if none are linked, the review stops and the user is prompted to configure linked XBerts first
Violations are grouped by policy category and per-violation follow-ups are drafted with spender tone
An audit pack is produced with the supporting evidence and the draft follow-ups for review
